scenarios.title: Friday platter on a Tuesday for double the price
scenarios.customerSays: Can I order your Friday platter on Tuesday if I promise to pay double?
scenarios.correctHandling: Explain that the Friday Family Machboos Platter is only cooked on Fridays and price does not change that. Offer: pre-order it now for collection on the coming Friday (up to 7 days ahead), or the Majlis Sharing Platter (AED 329, serves 4) on Tuesday.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: How many people, and whether Friday collection or a Tuesday alternative works.
mustNotPromise: Any special price or surcharge arrangement
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Always reject the Tuesday request; no escalation needed.

scenarios.title: 200 machboos in 20 minutes
scenarios.customerSays: I need 200 machboos meals in 20 minutes. Can you guarantee it?
scenarios.correctHandling: Say no clearly. 200 portions is a catering order needing 72 hours' notice, and Lamb Machboos is limited to 150 per day. Request a quote to obtain the earliest feasible date, offer a mix of machboos types, or pass to the events team.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Which machboos (lamb/chicken/vegetable), date, pickup or delivery area.
mustNotPromise: Any guarantee before the catering team confirms
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Reject the 20-minute deadline; escalate if they need more than the daily item limits allow.
expectedErrorCodes: Quote status not_possible / needs_changes with INSUFFICIENT_NOTICE, ITEM_DAILY_MAXIMUM_EXCEEDED

scenarios.title: Nut-free menu
scenarios.customerSays: Can you make the entire menu nut-free?
scenarios.correctHandling: No — tree nuts (walnuts, pine nuts, pistachios, almonds) are used in our single kitchen. Offer dishes with no nut ingredients (filter excludeAllergens=tree_nuts,peanuts) and options that leave nut garnishes off, with the trace warning.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Is this a severe allergy? If yes, recommend the duty manager.
mustNotPromise: That any dish is safe for a nut allergy
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Reject menu-wide nut-free; escalate severe allergies to the duty manager.

scenarios.title: Table for 12, maybe three people
scenarios.customerSays: I want to reserve a table for 12, but only three people might show up.
scenarios.correctHandling: Ask for the number of guests they realistically expect. Book for that number; they can increase it until 2 hours before, subject to availability. Explain a large table held for 12 may be reduced if far fewer arrive, and that bookings must reflect expected guests.
mustNotPromise: Holding a 12-seat table for three guests
That numbers can be increased on the day
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: No escalation; ask and book honestly.

scenarios.title: Delivery to Abu Dhabi in 15 minutes
scenarios.customerSays: Can you deliver to Abu Dhabi in 15 minutes?
scenarios.correctHandling: We only deliver within Dubai, and no delivery arrives faster than kitchen lead time plus drive time. Offer pickup at Al Seef.

scenarios.title: Vegan seafood platter
scenarios.customerSays: I want a vegan seafood platter.
scenarios.correctHandling: Explain we have no plant-based seafood. Ask whether they want vegan dishes (offer vegetable machboos, saloona dishes, lentil soup, nakhi, salad) or seafood (not vegan).

scenarios.title: Absolute cross-contamination guarantee
scenarios.customerSays: Can you guarantee that there is absolutely no cross-contamination?
scenarios.correctHandling: No. Read the kitchen allergen statement: one shared kitchen handles all listed allergens; we limit cross-contact but cannot guarantee. Recommend the duty manager for severe allergies.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Which allergy and which dish, so ingredients can be read out.
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Always decline the guarantee; escalate severe allergies.

scenarios.title: Sesame allergy and “the house sauce”
scenarios.customerSays: I am allergic to sesame. Is your house sauce definitely safe?
scenarios.correctHandling: Ask which dish or which house sauce. Al Ghaf House Red and House Green have no sesame ingredients; Sauce No. 7 contains sesame oil. Sesame is used in the kitchen, so none is “definitely safe”.
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Escalate to duty manager for a severe allergy.

scenarios.title: Keep the restaurant open late
scenarios.customerSays: Can you keep the restaurant open two hours after closing?
scenarios.correctHandling: No; hours cannot be extended on request. For a future private event, take details for the events team.
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Reject; offer events-team call-back for private events.

scenarios.title: Tomorrow's special, collected next month
scenarios.customerSays: Can I order tomorrow's special today for collection next month?
scenarios.correctHandling: Regular orders can be scheduled up to 7 days ahead and a weekday special is only served on its own weekday. Offer to take the order within the 7-day window on the right weekday, or to call back nearer the date.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Which special and which date next month.
mustNotPromise: Reserving the special a month ahead
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Reject; large orders can use catering (up to 90 days).

scenarios.title: Change a confirmed order to 50 meals at the same time
scenarios.customerSays: Can I change my confirmed order to 50 meals without changing the pickup time?
scenarios.correctHandling: No. 20+ portions make it a catering order needing at least 24 hours' notice; the original pickup time cannot be kept. Offer: keep the existing order, and/or request a catering quote for a later time.
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Reject; confirm the original order is unchanged.

scenarios.title: Guarantee a window table when all are booked
scenarios.customerSays: Can you promise a table by the window even if every window table is booked?
scenarios.correctHandling: No. Offer the nearest time with a window table, or another area at the requested time (the API lists both).
mustNotPromise: A window table that the API did not book

scenarios.title: Cheapest way to feed 15 people
scenarios.customerSays: What is the cheapest combination of items that feeds 15 people?
scenarios.correctHandling: Ask for the date and pickup/delivery, then use the feeding-suggestions endpoint and read back the cheapest options with totals. Mention it covers mains only and that more than 20 kitchen portions becomes a catering order.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Date, pickup or delivery, dietary needs.

scenarios.title: Reservation without a phone number
scenarios.customerSays: Can I reserve a table without giving a phone number?
scenarios.correctHandling: Explain a phone number is required for every booking (international numbers accepted with country code).
mustNotPromise: A booking without a phone number

scenarios.title: Identify a dish from a description
scenarios.customerSays: I don't know what the dish is called, but it has rice, meat, and dried lemon. Can you help me identify it?
scenarios.correctHandling: That is machboos (dried lemon = loomi). Suggest Lamb Machboos (AED 72); mention Chicken Machboos and Thursday's Camel Machboos; ask which meat.

scenarios.title: Iftar menu in October
scenarios.customerSays: Can I book the Ramadan iftar menu for this Saturday?
scenarios.correctHandling: The Iftar Set Menu is only served during Ramadan (provisionally 2027-02-08 to 2027-03-09). Offer the same dishes from the regular menu, or note the Ramadan dates.

scenarios.title: Pickup sooner than the kitchen can manage
scenarios.customerSays: I'm two minutes away — can my grilled hammour be ready when I arrive?
scenarios.correctHandling: No. Hammour takes 20 minutes plus buffer. Offer the earliest time returned by the API and place the order for that time if the customer agrees.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous “machboos”
scenarios.customerSays: Two machboos for pickup at seven please.
scenarios.correctHandling: Ask which machboos (lamb, chicken, vegetable; camel only on Thursdays), which day (today?), hashu with/without raisins, then quote and place the order.

scenarios.title: Order lookup with the wrong phone number
scenarios.customerSays: What's the status of order ORD-123456? (caller ID differs from the order phone)
scenarios.correctHandling: Ask for the phone number used when ordering and retry with X-Customer-Phone. After two failures offer a staff call-back; never reveal details of an unverified order.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Phone number used for the order.
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Escalate after repeated failures (API locks after 5).

scenarios.title: Cancel after cooking has started
scenarios.customerSays: Cancel my order, I'm not coming — it's due in 10 minutes.
scenarios.correctHandling: Try the cancel endpoint; if it returns CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED explain that cooking has started and pass the request to the team. Do not say it is cancelled.
mustNotPromise: Cancellation or refund the API did not confirm
scenarios.rejectOrEscalateWhen: Escalate when the window is closed.

scenarios.title: Large order pending confirmation
scenarios.customerSays: So my 40 lunch boxes are confirmed, right?
scenarios.correctHandling: Only if the order status is confirmed. A new catering order is pending_confirmation until the catering team calls (within 4 hours). Say “received, not yet confirmed”.

scenarios.title: Breakfast delivery
scenarios.customerSays: Can you deliver balaleet and karak to Business Bay at 9 am?
scenarios.correctHandling: Breakfast is not delivered and delivery starts at 12:00. Offer pickup before 11:30, or delivery of other dishes from 12:00.

scenarios.title: Harees sold out
scenarios.customerSays: I'd like four harees for tonight.
scenarios.correctHandling: Check availability; harees has a daily limit. If sold out (DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED / ITEM_SOLD_OUT), offer the next available date or alternatives returned by the API (e.g. thareed).

scenarios.title: Hidden fish in a starter
scenarios.customerSays: I'm allergic to fish. Are the regag bites okay?
scenarios.correctHandling: No — Mehyawa Regag Bites contain mehyawa, a fermented fish sauce (Cereals containing gluten (wheat), Eggs, Fish, Milk / dairy, Mustard). Suggest dishes without fish and mention shared equipment.

scenarios.title: Price haggling
scenarios.customerSays: Machboos is cheaper down the road — can you do it for AED 40?
scenarios.correctHandling: Prices are fixed (AED 72 for Lamb Machboos, VAT included). Only catering orders over 50 portions receive the published volume discount.

scenarios.title: Card number over the phone
scenarios.customerSays: Let me give you my card number so it's paid.
scenarios.correctHandling: Stop the caller from reading card details. Payment is in person (cash/card/Apple Pay on collection or delivery). Never record card numbers.

scenarios.title: Duplicate order after a dropped call
scenarios.customerSays: The call dropped — did my order go through? Place it again just in case.
scenarios.correctHandling: Retry the original create with the same Idempotency-Key (returns the original result) or look up recent orders by number/phone. Do not create a second order without asking.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: Do they want a second identical order?
mustNotPromise: A new order that duplicates the first
expectedErrorCodes: DUPLICATE_ORDER (if a new key is used for an identical order)

scenarios.title: Party of 25
scenarios.customerSays: Table for 25 on Friday night.
scenarios.correctHandling: The maximum bookable party is 20. Offer to pass the request to the events team or split into two bookings only if the guests are happy to sit separately.

scenarios.title: Terrace in July
scenarios.customerSays: Outdoor table on the terrace for 15 July please.
scenarios.correctHandling: The terrace is open 10-15 to 04-30 (month-day); offer window or indoor seating.

scenarios.title: Medical advice
scenarios.customerSays: I'm diabetic — which dish won't raise my blood sugar?
scenarios.correctHandling: Do not give medical advice. Share factual information (e.g. which dishes are sweet, that gahwa is unsweetened, karak can be ordered without sugar) and suggest they follow their doctor's guidance.
